title: Finite-span coefficient transport of ordinary module-derived operations
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ carry the extended $\ell$-adic topology, and use small representatives of small pro-etale sites in a common larger module universe [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site; def-weil-size-convention]. Let $C$ be the condensed ring of continuous functions on profinite sets taking values in a finite subextension of $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and put $A_Z=p_Z^*C$ for every scheme $Z$ [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed; sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Let $\mathcal R_Z$ be the sheafification of $V\mapsto\{f\in C(|V|,\Omega):\text{every point has an open neighbourhood on which }\operatorname{span}_{\mathbf Q_\ell}f\text{ is finite dimensional}\}$, with pointwise operations. For $v:Z\to W$ let $\rho_v:v^{-1}\mathcal R_W\to\mathcal R_Z$ be adjoint to precomposition with $|V\times_W Z|\to|V|$. Write $\alpha_v:v^{-1}A_W\xrightarrow{\sim}A_Z$ for the coefficient comparison [sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients].

Let $c_Z:A_Z\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal R_Z$ be the ring-sheaf isomorphism $\theta_Z$ of [lem-sf-locally-finite-coefficient-ring-realization], induced by the finite-extension continuous charts and characterized on every finite coefficient subextension by postcomposition into $\Omega$. Then
$$c_Z\alpha_v=\rho_v\,v^{-1}c_W.$$
In particular $\rho_v$ is invertible, and these identities respect composition of scheme morphisms. Reconstruct sectionwise modules from internal $A_Z$-modules and transport their action through $c_Z$ [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence; lem-sf-locally-finite-coefficient-ring-realization]. The resulting functor $E_Z$ is an exact equivalence onto $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal R_Z)$, preserves underlying abelian sheaves and all restrictions identically, and preserves finite free local trivializations.

For every $v:Z\to W$, the identity on underlying abelian sheaves gives natural comparisons
$$E_Wv_*^A\cong v_*^{\mathcal R}E_Z,\qquad E_Zv_A^*\cong v_{\mathcal R}^*E_W,$$
where direct image on the right uses precisely the precomposition coefficient action, and inverse image transports the action by $\alpha_v^{-1}$ or $\rho_v^{-1}$. These comparisons identify ordinary adjunction units, counits and inverse-image composition maps. Both equivalences preserve K-injective complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex], and induce comparisons of the ordinary total right derived direct images in unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category; def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. If the schemes are separated of finite type over a field of positive characteristic different from $\ell$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], the induced comparisons identify the canonical module-object derived adjunction with the sectionwise ringed-topos derived adjunction for each such $v$, namely the derived adjunction $v_{\mathcal R}^*\dashv Rv_*^{\mathcal R}$ obtained by deriving the ordinary module adjunction $v_{\mathcal R}^*\dashv v_*^{\mathcal R}$, that is, the adjunction for which the Hom transpose of the class of every chain map $v_{\mathcal R}^*L\to I$ into a K-injective complex $I$ is the class of its ordinary transpose $L\to v_*^{\mathcal R}I$, including units, counits and pullback composition maps. Consequently they carry the unit--square--counit exchange for any Cartesian square of such schemes to the derived counit mate on sectionwise modules over the actual inverse-image coefficient rings. This is equality of the specified morphisms under the comparisons, for every complex, with no constructibility or properness hypothesis.

proof.text: Apply locallyFiniteCoefficientRing_realization to obtain theta, its ring-hom structure, its finite-field chart equation and its coefficient square. Transpose the coefficient square under upperStarLowerStarAdjunction: homEquiv naturality on the left and right identifies its transpose with the inverse coefficient square. Since the pullback image of theta and condensedPullbackHom are invertible, cancelling the former proves IsIso rho. Apply lem-sf-finite-span-scalar-transport to the supplied theta and direct-image square. Its equality d.theta = theta lets the chart, direct coefficient square and transposed square fill three omitted clauses; the fourth omitted clause is the proved IsIso rho. Assemble all seventeen clauses of Properties.

Localize ordinary_composition using mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_comp. Evaluate the resulting equality of natural isomorphisms and simplify only whiskering and associators. Precompose and postcompose with compositor inverses to obtain the reversed equation. Apply square_pasting with index type X prime to Y and the equality s.w.symm to paste these two equations with the middle equality isomorphism. This proves comparison_square for every derived object.

Use the field_normalization clause for f and f prime to identify the derived mates of the two pullback comparison inverses with the two specified derived pushforward comparisons. Cancel the pullback comparison inverses in comparison_square to obtain the inverse-image cube. Apply exchangeMate_cube to the four derived adjunctions and this cube, then rewrite its two vertical mates using field_normalization. This is exactly ExchangeProperty, with no restriction on K and no claim of exchange invertibility. The canonical derived operations are bundled once. State the mate and pullback-exchange conditions for an abstract bundle, and extract commutativity from the pullback there before specializing, so proof-valued site instances and commutativity proofs are shared; expanding the bundle recovers the specified original equations.
